title: Constraining Errors in Ice Microphysics Schemes with Perturbed Ensembles
testbed_rationale: Presentation slides without public data links, code repository statements, or explicit access instructions.
pain_points: Difficulty comparing single-column model output against real-world observations (e.g., radar reflectivity, ice water content, precipitation rate)
Structural uncertainty (Unified Ice ON vs. OFF) complicates parametric uncertainty quantification
Constructing informative low-dimensional latent summary metrics from multi-dimensional time series
extraction_notes: Document is a presentation slide deck from the CESM Workshop AMWG meeting (dated June 15, 2026). The methods demonstrate using PCA and convolutional VAE latent spaces as summary metrics for MCMC parameter estimation.
